source_version: Terms of Use page dated 2026-06-13; REST API documentation dated 2026-06-14

license.notes: CDLI states that transliterations and translations may be copied, aggregated, and reused under common and fair academic practice with source acknowledgement. Images remain subject to institution/author rights and are not redistributed. The terms page does not state a single explicit licence for all catalogue metadata, so this project stores only minimal cited metadata and stable identifiers pending a clearer licence statement.

citation: Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative (CDLI), https://cdli.earth/, accessed 2026-08-21.

restrictions.images: Do not redistribute without item-specific permission or an explicit compatible licence.
restrictions.line_art: Do not redistribute without publication/author permission or explicit compatible licence.
restrictions.transliterations_and_translations: May be reused with academic attribution under the CDLI terms.
restrictions.metadata: Minimal cited fields only until an explicit dataset licence is confirmed.
